question: A bar magnet of length $10$ cm and pole strength $2$ A m is cut into two equal halves perpendicular to its length. The magnetic moment of each half is
solution: Cutting perpendicular to the length keeps the pole strength and halves the length: $M = 2 \times 0.05 = 0.1\ \text{A m}^2$ (half the original $0.2$).
